entry.title: D1 - D1 database undelete requests limited to the last 7 days
entry.content: The D1 undelete API now only accepts requests for databases that were deleted within the last 7 days. Requests to undelete a database that was deleted more than 7 days ago will fail and return an error. If you delete a D1 database by mistake, send the undelete request as soon as possible, and no later than 7 days after deletion. For more information, refer to the undelete D1 database API reference .

entry.content: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
entry.content: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
entry.content: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
entry.content: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Announcing Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway – expanding access to Cloudflare’s privacy-preserving infrastructure
entry.content: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
entry.content: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
entry.content: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare
entry.content: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update
entry.content: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks. By incorporating background telemetry from Cloudflare Challenge Pages, we have expanded our real-user measurement scale while maintaining user privacy.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
entry.content: We are introducing Clef and Clef-flash, open-source decision models hosted on Workers AI for high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Also launching: a new reinforcement learning platform that allows developers to fine-tune decision models using their own data.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: One year later: Sovereign AI and the fight for choice
entry.content: AI sovereignty is not a zero-sum game, but many governments now believe it is. Cloudflare's answer: more local open-source models, model-agnostic security tools, and a commitment to giving nations genuine choice.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Introducing Workers KV Instant — powered by Quicksilver
entry.content: Workers KV Instant delivers sub-2ms p99 read latencies and 250ms global replication across Cloudflare’s 300+ edge locations. KV Instant eliminates cold-read penalties and uses the familiar Workers KV API.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Cloudflare OS: your company’s agent workspace, managed for you
entry.content: Cloudflare OS gives everyone in your organization an agent workspace that knows how your company works and connects to its data and systems. We’re opening the waitlist for fully managed deployments that you’ll be able to launch in a few clicks.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Announcing Cloudflare K2: serverless event streams
entry.content: Cloudflare K2 is a serverless event streaming service built directly on top of R2 object storage for high-scale data movement and long-term retention. By decoupling producers and consumers at the edge, K2 enables durable, ordered log streams without the operational overhead of traditional broker clusters.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: We want you to build the next Git platform on Cloudflare
entry.content: Cloudflare is hosting a competition to see who will build the next Git platform for an era of AI agents. Artifacts is in open beta, with Workers bindings, data jurisdiction controls, and event subscriptions for repository changes.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: AI Search is now generally available
entry.content: AI Search is now generally available. It embeds image pixels directly for visual search, runs optical character recognition on scanned PDFs, accepts files up to 10 MiB, and works with any chat model. Here's what's new and how pricing works.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog

entry.title: Support for modern cryptographic algorithms in Workers
entry.content: Cloudflare Workers is adding opt-in support for post-quantum-resistant algorithms ML-KEM and ML-DSA. You can try it today.
entry.dc:creator: Cloudflare Blog
